item.title: Trump’s Summit With Xi Starts With Pomp and Pageantry
item.description: The summit marks Xi Jinping‘s first visit to Washington in more than a decade, as the two leaders look to ease brewing tensions over the war in Iran, artificial intelligence and trade.

item.title: America Is Behind on Memory Chips—and Tariffs Threaten to Make Things Harder
item.description: The Trump administration wants to spur U.S. chip-making, but tariffs on foreign imports could raise costs for American companies.

item.title: In France, a Baptism Boom Stirs Hope of Catholic Revival
item.description: Pope Leo plans to discuss the phenomenon with local church officials during his visit to France.

item.title: Oil Prices Jump on Houthi Attacks, U.S.-Iran Escalation Fears
item.description: Oil prices rose amid renewed Middle East escalation concerns after Saudi Arabia said it intercepted six ballistic missiles launched at the kingdom, while U.S.-Iran talks showed little sign of progress.

item.title: Trump Administration Presses China on Suspected Nuclear Tests in Confidential Talks
item.description: The discussions have occurred on the sidelines of multilateral meetings in Geneva, New York and Casablanca, Morocco.

item.title: War Throttles Black Sea Grain Exports, Threatening Food Supplies
item.description: Russian and Ukrainian attacks on ports and vessels have sent wheat futures to near three-year highs.

item.title: Best High-Yield Savings Accounts for September 2026: Up to 4.50%
item.description: These are the accounts that offer the best interest rates—without burdensome fees, gimmicks or other hassles

item.title: Netanyahu Returns to Familiar U.N. Stage More Isolated Than Ever
item.description: The Israeli prime minister’s speech on Thursday comes as he faces a tight election and weakening ties with the Trump administration.

item.title: Leonardo, Fincantieri Get $4.2 Billion Destroyer Contract For Italy’s Navy
item.description: Fincantieri will design and develop the naval platform and act as system integrator for the two DDX destroyers, while Leonardo will produce the combat system.

item.title: A Four-Year Truce Collapses and Ethiopia Is at War Again
item.description: Secessionist rebels seized three airports and battered government forces, returning the East African nation to civil war.

item.title: The Morning Risk Report: The Group Chat Where World Leaders Are Racing to Create AI Controls
item.description: $5 billion flurry of nearly identical Kalshi trades draws scrutiny, and more from Journal House U.N. General Assembly 2026.

item.title: Ukraine’s Economy Hampered by Black Sea, Energy Disruptions, Says EBRD
item.description: An agreement with Russia to halt attacks on energy infrastructure and the restoration of grain exports through the Black Sea, would boost Ukraine’s economy, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development said.

item.title: Iran Has a Secret Weapon in Its War With America: Help From China
item.description: Trump wants to preserve relations with Xi, but Iranian customs data show Chinese entities have made thousands of shipments of components used in drones and missiles.

item.title: Eight Navy Personnel Assigned to USS Lincoln Strike Group Attempted Suicide
item.description: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao divulged the number in response to questions from a Democratic senator.

item.title: From ‘Dictator’ Deputy to Trump Ally, Venezuela’s Leader Takes World Stage
item.description: Interim President Delcy Rodriguez’s appearance at the U.N. forces foreign leaders to interact with an authoritarian loyalist backed by Washington.

item.title: How the Panama Canal Became a 50-Mile Waterway With a $5 Million Ticket Price
item.description: High bids to use the waterway follow shipping disruptions from the Iran war and extreme weather.

item.title: U.S. Invites Putin to G-20 Summit at Trump Resort in Florida
item.description: President Trump and Russian leader Vladimir Putin haven’t met in person since the Alaska summit in August 2025.

item.title: The Group Chat Where World Leaders Are Racing to Create AI Controls
item.description: An island meeting and texts between the leaders of Canada, France and Norway reveal an emerging alliance: “We’re in.”

item.title: Canada’s Carney Open to U.S. Trade Deal but Won’t Give Up Right to Deepen EU Ties
item.description: In a WSJ interview, the Canadian Prime Minister said like-minded countries must work together to ensure sovereignty.

item.title: Putin Casts Election Result as an Endorsement of His War
item.description: The Russian leader called on Russia’s military to step up its advance in Ukraine after a successful result for his ruling party.
